thesis: Rank the answer, not the offer, still holds for informational demand: SC reference pages, explainer posts and attorney bios earn the site's clicks (blog 1,393, resources 575, attorneys 330 in 90 days).

The offer layer is broken. The 25 two-state pillars earned 10 clicks in 90 days at positions 40–86. The office × practice pages that ranked 9–30 on the largest demand were retired on 09-18/19 and 301 to those pillars.

Competitors win '[city] car/truck accident lawyer' with a dedicated page for that practice in that city (Savannah, Columbia, Myrtle Beach) and '[city] personal injury lawyer' with a homepage or a strong city page; Maps traffic lands on whatever URL the Google Business Profile links to.
So: a small, capped, hand-built office practice layer, funded one-for-one out of the geo budget, with the office hub as the Business Profile landing page and the reference layer feeding both.
